svg.title: Samiullah Akram, Full Stack Developer
svg.desc: Available for remote & freelance work. Hi! I'm Samiullah, a Full-Stack Developer who designs, builds and ships production web apps: AI-powered SaaS, real-time systems and payment-ready platforms with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js and PostgreSQL. Now: Full-Stack Developer at JayTech Elite Firm, building SmokeScreen V2.
